name: Egor Demin
detail: Demin (leg) stated he isn't sure if he will be able to play in Friday's game against Detroit, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Coby White
detail: Head coach Charles Lee said Monday that White (calf) remains without a timeline for a return, though Lee added that he'll have a better idea of where things stand following the Hornets' two-game road trip, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.

name: Kon Knueppel
detail: Knueppel (hamstring) is without a timetable for a return, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.

name: Grant Williams
detail: Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated following Charlotte's upcoming two-game road trip, Rod Boone reports.

name: Tobe Awaka
detail: Awaka (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Knicks, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.

name: Patrick Williams
detail: Williams (adductor) won't play in Wednesday's game against the Knicks, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.

name: Nic Claxton
detail: Claxton (hamstring) participated in individual drills Monday morning and hopes to join the team for practice next week, Joe Cowley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

name: Naji Marshall
detail: Marshall (illness) won't play in Wednesday's game against Oklahoma City.

name: Tarik Biberovic
detail: Biberovic (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.

name: Santi Aldama
detail: Aldama (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.

name: Sergio de Larrea
detail: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.

name: Cameron Johnson
detail: Johnson (ankle) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans.

name: Spencer Jones
detail: Jones (hamstring) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against New Orleans.

name: Alpha Diallo
detail: Diallo is out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans due to personal reasons.

name: Isaiah Joe
detail: Joe (hip) is out for Wednesday's game against the Hornets.

name: Gui Santos
detail: Santos has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Timberwolves due to left knee tendinitis.

name: Kristaps Porzingis
detail: The Warriors are exploring potential trades involving Porzingis (personal), who remains away from the team indefinitely while dealing with ongoing health concerns, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

name: Marcus Smart
detail: Smart (forearm) is out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.

name: Alperen Sengun
detail: Sengun (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.

name: Steven Adams
detail: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

name: T.J. McConnell
detail: Pacers head coach Rick Carlisle stated McConnell (hamstring) is "doing better" and "getting closer" to a return, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

name: Ben Sheppard
detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

name: Tyrese Haliburton
detail: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Ivica Zubac
detail: Zubac (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the 76ers.

name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
detail: Niederhauser (foot) remains out for Wednesday's game against the Lakers. He also won't travel with the team for the upcoming two-game road trip in Minnesota and Golden State, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Max Strus
detail: Strus (foot) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Brandon Ingram
detail: Ingram (Achilles) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Rui Hachimura
detail: Hachimura (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Lakers, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.

name: Cameron Carr
detail: Carr (oblique) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

name: Adou Thiero
detail: Thiero (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

name: Ziaire Williams
detail: Williams (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

name: Luka Doncic
detail: Doncic (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

name: Simone Fontecchio
detail: Fontecchio (illness) is out for Wednesday's game against the Hawks.

name: Anthony Edwards
detail: Edwards will undergo arthroscopic right knee surgery and is expected to miss up to two months, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Jordan Poole
detail: Poole (ankle) won't return to Wednesday's game against the Nuggets. He finished with two points (1-3 FG, 0-1 3Pt), one rebound and one steal over seven minutes.

name: Jose Alvarado
detail: Alvarado (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Bulls.

name: Jalen Williams
detail: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

name: Alex Caruso
detail: Caruso (ankle) is expected to miss time due to an ankle sprain, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

name: Thomas Sorber
detail: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.

name: Chet Holmgren
detail: Holmgren (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.

name: Nikola Topic
detail: Topic (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game in Dallas.

name: Cason Wallace
detail: Wallace has been diagnosed with a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Jonathan Isaac
detail: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Wednesday's game against the Raptors.

name: Jalen Suggs
detail: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Tacko Fall
detail: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Wednesday's game in Indiana.

name: Jabari Walker
detail: Walker (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Pacers.

name: Oso Ighodaro
detail: Ighodaro (oblique) is feeling better and considered day-to-day ahead of Friday's game against the Nuggets, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.

name: Chris Youngblood
detail: Youngblood (ankle/two-way player) is out for Tuesday's game against the Lakers.

name: Dylan Cardwell
detail: Cardwell (calf) will be re-evaluated in one week, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

name: Maxime Raynaud
detail: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

name: Keegan Murray
detail: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

name: Tobias Harris
detail: Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Utah, Paul Garcia of ProjectSpurs.com reports.

name: Nate Bittle
detail: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Magic, Cody Taylor of USA Today reports.

name: Kawhi Leonard
detail: Leonard (knee) is expected to miss multiple weeks due to swelling in his left knee, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Lauri Markkanen
detail: Markkanen (wrist) is out for Wednesday's tilt against the Spurs.

name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Tre Johnson
detail: Johnson has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers due to right Achilles soreness.

name: Justin Champagnie
detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
